final_answer.key_evidence_summary: adservice pod adservice-645c94d6-9jrbk is the only outlier in the boutique pods listing (READY 1/1, RESTARTS 2, 28s ago) while all 10 peer services show 0 restarts. Pod detail shows Last State Terminated with Exit Code 143 (SIGTERM from kubelet, not 137/OOMKilled) and Restart Count 2, with events: Normal Killing 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x2 over 60s) and Warning Unhealthy 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service 172.20.1.125:8080 within 1s: context deadline exceeded' (x8 over 80s). GetErrorLogs(adservice) returned no error logs, indicating the process is healthy and was killed externally. GetAppYAML(adservice) confirms the mismatch: containerPort 9555 with env PORT=9555, readinessProbe grpc port 9555 (correct), but livenessProbe grpc port 8080 - a port the gRPC-only adservice never listens on; the Service adservice also maps port/targetPort 9555. Probe against 8080 can never succeed, so after failureThreshold=3 kubelet kills the container (exit 143) and restarts it, producing the abnormal restart loop while readiness on 9555 keeps the pod reported Ready.
